snippet.title: An Ecospace of Epochs - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Itch.io / download: https://amaxivermis.itch.io/an-ecospace-of-epochs
Game hompage: https://amaxivermis.neocities.org/
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/anecospaceofepochs.bsky.social
Note: Steam isn't here just yet, this will be decided on soon

The trailer for the demo as of 0.2, but a public demo is available as of now, so give it a try!

Game description:
You're a paleontologist in a far future from a different planet in an interconnected universe, you've got a new home that's yours in the sparsely populated part of the planet and you help with studying the past life and world spanning nearly a billion years ago.

Music credit: Audioplastic [New title theme sample track]
